captureDefaults.html: Chromium 1440x1800 CSS px; DPR 1; 100% zoom; light; animations disabled
captureDefaults.output: PNG and accessible dossier HTML; preserve source text as live text in the review surface
captureDefaults.cropRule: Crop to the named region plus no more than 24 CSS px or 48 raster px of neutral context; omit marks and unrelated adjacent material.
captureDefaults.compositeRule: A composite must preserve source order, wording, capitalization and punctuation; visually label omitted gaps; never splice text into a new sentence.
captureDefaults.attributionPlacement: Visible immediately below the capture at 16 px minimum on the 1200×1500 review canvas; source title, publisher, version/date, canonical URL, access date, license/notice link and no-endorsement statement.
